description: Re-run of constrained PSLQ for N_v using bar-self-dual cell-content trace tr_pure(σ_1^4 σ_3^6 σ_5^8) as the structural input, replacing the demoted Plancherel-weighted N_sym from the prior basis. Tests three ansatz shapes B1/B2/B3 against CODATA-G_F precision.
conclusion: Bar-self-duality of tr_pure imposes a strong structural constraint. The bar-symmetric ansatz B3 yields a smaller basis (lower FDR) than the prior monomial search. Any hit found is suggestive but still requires categorical authoring of the F-shape, not just numerical confirmation.
